paragraphs: R. Yishmael son of R. Yonah; R. Ze'eira; Resh Lakish, in R. Yishmael's name, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter 1 of Ḥallah; Pesaḥim, chapter 2, halakhah 4. But the plain sense in Sedeh Yehoshua is: R. Yose, in R. Shimon's name: 'R. Yishmael recited thus.' And R. Yonah, R. Ze'eira, and Resh Lakish, in R. Yishmael's name: 'bread, bread.' Understand this: there was no R. Yishmael son of R. Yonah [in this construction].
